Workshop.Title: Expansão de Classes e Arquétipos
Workshop.NoActor: No Character selected. Open the tool from a character sheet.

Elixirs.Description: Whenever you finish a Long Rest while holding Alchemist's Supplies, produce experimental elixirs. You can also expend a spell slot (Magic action) to create an additional elixir with a chosen effect.
Elixirs.RollHint: Rolls 1d6 and creates the rolled elixir in your inventory.
Elixirs.ChoiceHint: Expend a spell slot to produce an elixir with a specific effect.

Tinker.Description: As a Magic action while holding Tinker's Tools, you can create one mundane item in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. It lasts until your next Long Rest.

Replicate.Description: Arcane plans used to replicate magic items. Created items last until you die (1d4 days after) or replace the plan.

Companions.Description: Special mechanical companions and arcane constructs available to Artificer specializations.

Admin.Description: Administrative tools for Game Masters to populate and synchronize the compendiums.

Healing.Name: Experimental Elixir: Healing
Healing.Desc: Drinker regains 2d8 + Int modifier HP (3d8 at lvl 9, 4d8 at lvl 15).

Swiftness.Name: Experimental Elixir: Swiftness
Swiftness.Desc: Drinker's Speed increases by 10 ft for 1 hour (15 ft at lvl 9, 20 ft at lvl 15).

Resilience.Name: Experimental Elixir: Resilience
Resilience.Desc: +1 bonus to AC for 10 minutes (1 hour at lvl 9, 8 hours at lvl 15).

Boldness.Name: Experimental Elixir: Boldness
Boldness.Desc: Add 1d4 to every attack roll and saving throw for 1 minute (10m at lvl 9, 1h at lvl 15).

Flight.Name: Experimental Elixir: Flight
Flight.Desc: Gain Fly Speed of 10 ft for 10 minutes (20 ft at lvl 9, 30 ft at lvl 15).

Choice.Name: Experimental Elixir: Choice
Choice.Desc: Choose any one of the other effects on the table.

SteelDefender.Name: Steel Defender
SteelDefender.Description: Construct companion built by a Battle Smith. Uses Force-Empowered Rend, Repair, and Deflect Attack.

Homunculus.Name: Homunculus Servant
Homunculus.Description: Tiny flying construct summoned via the 2nd-level Homunculus Servant spell.

EldritchCannon.Name: Eldritch Cannon
EldritchCannon.Description: Magical cannon deployed by an Artillerist: Flamethrower, Force Ballista, or Protector.

Notifications.CompendiumsSynced: Expansão de Classes e Arquétipos: Successfully synchronized {count} documents across all compendiums!
Notifications.TinkerItemCreated: Conjured {name} in {actor}'s inventory (lasts until next Long Rest)!
Notifications.CompanionNotFound: Companion sheet not found in the compendium.

EnableSheetButton.Name: Enable Sheet Button
EnableSheetButton.Hint: Adds an Expansão de Classes e Arquétipos button to the header of character sheets.

AutoSync.Name: Auto-sync Compendiums
AutoSync.Hint: Automatically checks and synchronizes compendium packs upon world launch if empty or language changes.

SyncedLanguage.Name: Synced Compendiums Language
SyncedLanguage.Hint: Tracks which language was populated into the compendiums for automatic synchronization.

Menu.Name: Expansão de Classes e Arquétipos
Menu.Label: Open Expansão de Classes e Arquétipos
Menu.Hint: Open the Expansão de Classes e Arquétipos management window.

Class.Name: Witch Hunter
Class.Description: Warriors who utilize forbidden hemocraft and dark rituals to hunt the most terrible evils of the multiverse.
